category_role: Predeclared benchmark scope only; metadata is not an online classifier or an input to numerical estimation. All short-circuit rows remain NOT_APPLICABLE in the primary denominator.
initial_state: Observed t0 frequency offset is added using immutable evaluation COI weights; zero incremental governor state around the pre-event operating point is assumed. Initial electrical power approximates mechanical output for a branch sanity check.
governor_scope: Unconstrained linear primary-frequency response. Future saturation, temperature selection, reserve activation and rate limits are not reconstructed; therefore this is a qualified analytical approximation, not an exact PSS/E surrogate.
failure_policy: Out-of-scope short circuits, known initial branch violations, unsupported multiple outages, absent physical inputs and roots retain explicit non-OK rows with empty primary predictions. Nonpositive estimated deficits are not applicable to native FNP.
timing_scope: Shared causal-array estimator, state mapping, baseline aggregation and checks plus method parameter aggregation/range selection and prediction. File reads, identity hashing and prepared device tables are separate. FNP fit-range lookup is charged online.
